item.title: Zero-Trust Ingress with Traefik + Authorino - Group-Based Authorization
item.description: Implementing group-based authorization at the ingress level ensures that sensitive applications are only accessible to authorized user groups. This post covers implementing zero-trust ingress with Traefik + Authorino where different ingress routes are only visible to specific user groups.
